_about: The C6's first-light ratchet (docs/first-light-ratchet.md): `first_light_ms` is the firmware's own `[perf] first light at <ms> ms`, read off a ROM-up power-on boot of the split image through our bootloader on lp-emu:esp32c6:t4, projects/test/basic with a saved Wi-Fi network on the emulated LAN, the higher of two boots. CI fails above 500 ms, warns above 400 ms, fails more than 5 ms above this value until Yona blesses it (`just bless-first-light`, label `first-light-blessed`), and hands back a patch when it drops. `recorded_by`: initial | ci-ratchet | emulator-model | yona.
